name: RuneScape 2 Vita
author: bren
description: Unofficial PS Vita port of RuneScape 2 (2004), built on Client3 and the LostCity server. Plays revisions 225, 274 and 289. Single-player worlds run on the Vita itself and can be hosted for friends over LAN or ad-hoc, and online community servers are supported too. Everything is included in the vpk. Not affiliated with Jagex.
